label: If BEGINS_2 is possible, possibly with an actual external concurrent giver of contingent being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred, in the memberwise concurrent-esse sense of causation: if a BEGINS_2 populated history is accessible from the selected world, then an accessible BEGINS_2 populated history has an actually existing concrete individual c outside the contingent concrete inventory such that the shared CausalityFrame.GivesAt relation holds from c to every contingent concrete member at every moment of its presence, with at least one actual exercise. Unlike the existing B2's unconstrained totality-cause marker 256b5bab, this source exercises an explicit causal primitive within its possible world. GivesAt is taken on its strict esse-giving reading (definition 158301bc); the universal clause is CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 restricted to temporally present contingent concreta (disambiguation 88a8fba7). This is stronger than holistic totality causation and still includes the possibility of a necessary external bearer. It does not establish giving of being in the actual world, require a first moment, or infer physical realizability from modal syntax.
